warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery SDV8 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The TDV8 or SDV8 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV8 or SDV8 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 or SDV8 rebuild.
Because the Discovery SDV8 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Discovery 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established TDV8 or SDV8 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
